body: Live-diff follow-up, no edit and not yet a verdict: the colon-split identity problem is structurally fixed in Validated.equals/hash and canonicalParts, but two admission seams remain. (1) ProviderNodeId.from still admits NUL/control characters because it rejects only whitespace; AcceptedAlignmentSidecar feeds nodeId.value as a separate ContentAddress.digest part, whose NUL separator makes boundary injection possible. Please reject control chars (at minimum U+0000) and add a direct NUL court. (2) platformIncompatible canonicalizes with sortBy(_.render). Distinct Custom("a:b","c") / Custom("a","b:c") have equal render, so the stored supportedPlatforms order and checksum can depend on caller order even though the factory treats this as a set (duplicate test + canonicalization). Sort by an injective structural key/canonicalParts and add an input-permutation test with that equal-render pair. The same control-char admission question applies to RuntimeComponent.Dependency and Custom platform/resource fields because they enter ContentAddress parts. Please address before freezing the successor or explain the intended identity contract.
